body:
## Pull request overview

This PR implements the remaining ObjectStack Spec v0.8.2 features to increase console alignment from ~80% to ~95% (34/36 features). It focuses on app-level enhancements, routing improvements, and navigation features to create a more complete specification-compliant console.

**Changes:**
- Added dynamic favicon and document title updates via app branding
- Implemented default app selection and active app filtering
- Added collapsible navigation groups with expand/collapse state
- Created new route handlers for dashboards and custom pages
- Added support for view names and URL parameters in navigation

## Variable not declared before use

Variable 'activeApp' is used before its [declaration](1).

[Show more details](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/security/code-scanning/266)

The function uses `any` type for the `record` parameter, which bypasses TypeScript's type safety. Consider defining an interface for record objects (e.g., `Record<string, any>` or a more specific type) to improve type safety and maintainability.

The default state logic `item.expanded !== false` treats undefined/null as true (expanded). Consider making this more explicit with `item.expanded ?? true` for better clarity about the intended default behavior.
```suggestion
    const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = React.useState(item.expanded ?? true);
```
